g.text: Zephyr device selection: build, initialize, then use
Z4 · Common statically configured MCU path · dynamic buses and deferred initialization are exceptions
Devicetree describes hardware; Kconfig selects software. DEVICE_DT_GET yields a pointer, not readiness or exclusive ownership.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
